component.name: Ferrite
component.summary: High-performance, multi-protocol download manager and accelerator

description.p: Ferrite is a fast, telemetry-free download accelerator written in Rust. It combines an ultra-fast asynchronous core with a sleek, GPU-accelerated graphical interface built with GPUI.

ul.li: High-throughput multi-connection HTTP/HTTPS downloads with dynamic byte-range splitting
Full BitTorrent client featuring sequential downloading, piece streaming, and magnet link handling
Native HLS (m3u8) video stream capturing and parallel segment downloading
Automated wildcard batch downloads and URL sequence expansion
Cross-browser Native Messaging integration for Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, and Opera
Daemon mode with local Unix IPC and optional encrypted LAN remote control
Zero telemetry, zero ads, and 100% open source

screenshot.caption: Main window displaying active downloads, real-time speed charts, and media preview

description.p: Renamed the project, binaries, and bundle identifiers to Ferrite with automatic one-time migration from legacy data directories.
Added native Linux ARM64 (aarch64) support and unified release asset naming across macOS and Linux, alongside fixes for Linux clipboard copy/paste and HTTP 403 download failures.
Full native Linux GPUI support (Wayland/X11), multi-distro packaging (.deb, .rpm, AppImage, AUR, Flatpak), Linux OS integration, and workspace-wide stability improvements.
Comprehensive multi-distribution Linux GUI support and packaging release.
Initial release with HTTP engine, BitTorrent sequential streaming, and macOS desktop app.
